sorry_nodes.description: Main theorem: Binary GCD computes correct GCD
sorry_nodes.proof_strategy: Apply axiom binaryGCDOddLoop_correct, then show gcd(a,b) = 2^k * gcd(a/2^ka, b/2^k)
sorry_nodes.notes: Core requires showing composition of even-factor extraction with loop correctness

sorry_nodes.description: Extended Binary GCD satisfies Bezout identity: a*x + b*y = gcd
sorry_nodes.sorry_context: Requires termination proof for partial def
sorry_nodes.proof_strategy: Strong induction on b. Base: b=0 trivial. Inductive: standard extended Euclidean unfolding
sorry_nodes.notes: May need to refactor extendedBinaryGCD to use explicit termination measure (Nat.lt_wfRel on a+b)

sorry_nodes.description: Modular inverse via extended GCD is correct
sorry_nodes.proof_strategy: From Bezout identity a*x + m*y = 1, derive a*x ≡ 1 (mod m)

sorry_nodes.description: Garner reconstruction is exact: garnerReconstruct(garnerConvert(n)) = n
sorry_nodes.sorry_context: Full proof requires detailed induction over garnerConvert/garnerReconstruct
sorry_nodes.proof_strategy: Induction on number of tiers. Use CRT uniqueness from Mathlib (ZMod.chineseRemainder)
sorry_nodes.notes: Core mathematical content is CRT uniqueness. Garner is just mixed-radix encoding

sorry_nodes.description: Nodup is preserved when appending new prime to tiers
sorry_nodes.sorry_context: Requires showing new_prime > max(tiers) implies new_prime not in tiers
sorry_nodes.proof_strategy: Use foldl max property: forall x in L, x <= L.foldl max 0. Then new_prime > max contradicts membership

sorry_nodes.description: CRT and Garner reconstruction give same result
sorry_nodes.sorry_context: Requires full crtReconstruct implementation with actual modular inverses
sorry_nodes.proof_strategy: Both compute unique solution to system of congruences. By CRT uniqueness, they are equal
sorry_nodes.notes: May need to implement proper crtReconstruct first, or restructure proof to avoid it

sorry_nodes.sorry_context: Full proof requires detailed unfolding and garner_exact
sorry_nodes.proof_strategy: Apply garner_exact to (a + b), show component-wise modular addition is correct
sorry_nodes.notes: Uses Nat.add_mod lemma for modular arithmetic

sorry_nodes.description: Curvature tuple sequences are eventually periodic
sorry_nodes.sorry_context: Pigeonhole + cycling argument for finite state space
sorry_nodes.proof_strategy: Pigeonhole on M^4 states. Any sequence longer than M^4 must repeat. Deterministic iteration implies eventual periodicity
sorry_nodes.notes: Core is Fintype.pigeonhole or similar from Mathlib
